parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The traffic direction of the access control policy.

Valid value:

- **out**: outbound traffic.

parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description:
The IP version. Valid value:

- **4** (default): IPv4

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: NatGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT Gateway.
